units.source_text: 一楼大厅壁龛正面，坐着本因坊名人和挑战者大竹七段。

en.t: In front of the alcove in the first-floor hall sat the Honinbo Master and his challenger, Otake 7-dan.

units.source_text: 名人的左侧，还有将棋名人关根十三世、木村，连珠棋 [1] 名人高木。

en.t: To the Master's left were also the shogi masters Sekine the Thirteenth and Kimura, and Takagi, the renju master [1].

units.source_text: 也就是说，四位名人并排而坐。

en.t: In other words, four masters were seated side by side.

units.source_text: 将棋和连珠棋的名人在观摩围棋名人的对局。

en.t: The masters of shogi and renju were observing the go master's match.

units.source_text: 这些名人是应报社的邀请齐聚一堂的。

en.t: These masters had gathered there at the invitation of the newspaper company.

units.source_text: 我作为观战记者，坐在高木名人旁边。

en.t: As the match reporter, I sat beside Master Takagi.

units.source_text: 大竹七段右侧，坐着举办这场棋赛的报社主笔和主编、日本棋院的理事和监事、

en.t: On Otake 7-dan's right sat the newspaper company's chief editorial writer and editor in chief, who were sponsoring the match, as well as directors and auditors of the Nihon Ki-in,

units.source_text: 三位七段围棋长老，以及列席棋赛的小野田六段。

en.t: three elder go players ranked 7-dan, and Onoda 6-dan, who was also in attendance at the match.

units.source_text: 本因坊门下的棋手也出席了。

en.t: Players from the Honinbo school were present as well.
